A '''veranda''' in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was decorated with stained [[Glass/Legends|glass]] windows. One of them depicted<ref name="LL" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi Lord]]<ref name="JVS 4">[[Jedi vs. Sith 4|''Jedi vs. Sith'' 4]]</ref> [[Valenthyne Farfalla]]<ref name="LL" /> who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Ruusan campaign]] of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="JVS 4" />

Upon their return to the Jedi Temple after [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] reclaimed her [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]] from the underworld criminals [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] and [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] conversed with Tano as they walked the halls. Confident that she had learned the necessity of patience, Sinube had one final request of the Padawan before they parted ways: to pass on what she had learned. He then led her to a classroom of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], who were being instructed in the basics of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] by Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. Sinube greeted the diminutive Master and stood next to him, while Tano explained the importance of keeping track of one's own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="LL" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tales_of_the_Jedi_TCW_sketches.png|thumb|right|250px|Concept sketches of Odan-Urr, Nomi Sunrider and Ulic Qel-Droma from ''The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars''.]]
An unidentified veranda first appeared in "[[Lightsaber Lost]]," the eleventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="LL" /> It was first pictured by [[Wayne Lo]] in his unused concept sketch titled "Jedi Temple stained glass art sketches" in the ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars (booklet)|The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' booklet, released with the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition]]. The sketches depicted [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]], [[Nomi Sunrider]] and [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]],<ref name="The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars">{{StoryCite|story=The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars (booklet)|book=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|bformatted=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|sformatted=''The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars''|smanual=1}}</ref> the characters from the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] book series [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Tales of the Jedi">[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'' comic series]]</ref>

[[File:Jedi_Temple_stained_glass_concept_art.png|thumb|right|250px|Jedi Temple stained glass concept art]]
The complete artwork was included in the production journal of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two]]''.<ref name="TCW CS2">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]</ref> The first pair of images depicted Nomi Sunrider [[Sever Force/Legends|severing]] Ulic Qel-Droma's connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] from the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|sixth issue]] of the comic book miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''.<ref name="The Sith War 6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> The third pair of images depicted Odan-Urr and his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ooroo/Legends|Ooroo]] in the library, and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="TCW CS2" /> The fourth pair depicted [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] leading the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]], and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Jedi Master [[Pernicar]]. The last pair depicted [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]] putting a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] minion in [[Force Stasis/Legends|stasis field]] and the arrival of Farfalla from the [[2006]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''.<ref name="PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>
